purpose: Bounded development public EN/AF entry, atomic individual Account registration and explicit protected email verification without creating a Session.

implementation_revision.semantics: WELL-131 replaces the starter entry with the existing governed registration composition, adds Content-owned current development eligibility to presentation and Identity acceptance, and proves the ordinary EN/AF journey. Existing durable registration, PMR, verification, Communications and Audit lifecycles are reused unchanged.

collaborating_domains.ownership: MessageIntent, protected envelope and nonce reservation; registration establishes intent, not delivery.
Registration evidence obligation and initial materialization schedule.
Exact development legal identifiers, immutable artifacts and owner-approved bilingual subset. Readers grant no public release approval or production eligibility.

ash.caller_boundary: Internal transactional action. Application callers use Identity.register/1.
Private Account creation from the acceptance action; not a browser API.
AshAuthentication token resource; JWT issuance remains inside owner acceptance.

arguments: Atom-keyed map: operation_id UUIDv4, first_name, surname, email, password, preferred_language (en/af atom or string), confirmed_age_18? true, terms_version_id, privacy_version_id.
Nonblank names, nonempty password, accepted canonical mailbox and exact currently eligible Content-owned development legal versions are required. Identity rechecks eligibility inside acceptance.
returns: {:ok, %RegistrationResult{status: :verification_pending, account_id: UUID | nil, verification_proof: token | nil}}
Ordinary failure paths include {:error, :invalid_registration} and {:error, :registration_unavailable}; unexpected exceptions are not universally caught.
side_effects: New acceptance commits Account/credential/PMR/verification Token/operation plus Communications intent/envelope and Audit obligation/schedule in one Ash transaction.
Exact replay repeats no acceptance writes and returns no proof. Duplicate canonical email creates only a neutral operation binding.
No provider I/O or authenticated browser session.
caller_constraints: Never log or expose the transient verification_proof to browser callers.
Purpose-bound internal authorize?: false calls do not grant a general authorization bypass.

side_effects: Read only. Revalidates exact configured version pair, current manifest applicability/withdrawal/supersession/context and both pinned artifact bytes.
caller_constraints: Development/test compilation only; production denies even with matching runtime settings. No participant-approved legal successor is supplied here.

arguments: Transient purpose-bound verification bearer, supplied by explicit participant POST only.
side_effects: Existing Identity action consumes the current proof and verifies the Account once under database locks. No Session.
caller_constraints: GET/HEAD/prefetch never call this interface. Reuse current stored-proof, purpose, expiry, Account/security and revocation guards.

arguments: One of the fixed document atoms :terms or :privacy.
side_effects: Reads only fixed source artifacts and the current eligibility manifest. No publication or acceptance mutation.
caller_constraints: Development/test compilation and the exact configured legal pair are required; callers cannot supply a path or approve release.

arguments: Semantic key in the 48-key owner-approved UI subset.
Exact en/af locale as string or atom.
Map containing only configured platform_name replacement, when the key needs it.
returns: Exact selected locale string with configured token substitution; raises on unavailable artifact, key, locale or token.
side_effects: Reads pinned artifact bytes to recheck eligibility; no durable write or publication.
caller_constraints: No fallback, no new governed wording, no production or real-participant eligibility. The web CopyRegistry is a thin adapter.

request_flow.summary: GET / and /register share the existing registration composition. Explicit development enablement plus current exact copy/legal eligibility admit the normal journey; old proof browser flags are unnecessary. Endpoint telemetry still redacts sensitive paths.
RegistrationController.create/2 validates browser input, then calls Identity.register/1; response is neutral and creates no session.
Identity checks operation replay, validates admission and allocates PMR; internal accept_registration action owns the source transaction.
AcceptRegistration.run/3 creates Account, verification challenge, Communications intent, Audit obligation/schedule, then binds operation.
Commit returns verification_pending; email delivery and verification consumption are separate capabilities.

Neutral pending keeps its locale on public-entry links and explicit resend. Communications delivers the protected proof through its owner. Passive confirmation renders exact temporary EN/AF copy; explicit CSRF POST calls Identity.verify_email/1 and renders verified or common unavailable without authenticating.

states: unrecorded (request phase, not a persisted enum)

transitions.from_state: unrecorded (request phase, not a persisted enum)
guards: Validated immutable request, UUIDv4, legal/content/key eligibility and successful transaction.
Uniqueness arbitrates email, PMR and operation ID.
side_effects: Commit acceptance write set, or neutral duplicate-email binding.

guards: Before 24-hour expiry; same HMAC-bound input and matching password verifier; required old keys/provider supported.
side_effects: Return previous result with nil verification_proof; do not repeat acceptance.

guards: Operation expiry; replay independently rejects expired operations even before sweep.
side_effects: Clear replay/binding/result material, preserve operation UUID reservation; background expiry works in bounded batches.

security_invariants.summary: Identity owns Account, credential, PMR, verification challenge and registration operation; cross-Domain consequences use owning interfaces.
Neutral duplicate-email result must not reveal whether an Account exists; password and transient token are sensitive.
Development legal/browser fixtures are not production legal or release approval.

The reader exposes only the 48 UI keys in the two approved compositions and checks pinned registry/composition bytes on use. Legal artifacts remain DEVELOPMENT_ONLY_CURRENT, NOT_LEGALLY_APPROVED and not participant-effective. Runtime flags cannot promote a production build.

concurrency.summary: PostgreSQL unique identities arbitrate concurrent email/PMR/operation acceptance; process-local memory is not authority.
PMR collision retries allocation up to five attempts; email collision binds neutral result; operation collision rereads/replays.

idempotency_retry.summary: Exact immutable replay requires request fingerprint and slow password verifier; changed payload, key loss, expiry or tombstone refuses.
Do not retry by inventing new operation IDs to bypass expired or contradictory binding.

failure_recovery.summary: Returned failure inside transactional accept_registration rolls back source and owner consequences; scheduled job is not acceptance authority.
Lost response is reconciled via the same operation ID and immutable payload. Replay returns no bearer.
Tombstones preserve non-reuse, while unavailable old fingerprint keys/verifiers fail closed.

Missing, mismatched, withdrawn or superseded legal artifacts deny presentation and new acceptance. Existing durable retries and recovery remain owner-controlled; no new business state, migration, cache, provider or background worker is introduced.

cases: Registration validation, exact replay, changed payload/password and tombstone/expiry refusal.
tests.proves: Executable focused primitive/replay coverage in repository.
tests.limits: Source inspected here; do not transfer historical run results to this map revision.

cases: Owner write set, rollback, concurrent acceptance and duplicate-email neutrality.
tests.proves: Actual Ash/PostgreSQL orchestration tests with independent connection race helpers.
tests.limits: No claim that JSON validation executes these tests or proves production delivery.

cases: Real new and canonical-duplicate registrations return the same normalized status, complete response body, messages, redirect/security headers and session result; only submitted email and per-session CSRF/resend tokens are normalized.
Registration response does not expose Account identifiers and keeps the neutral accepted copy.
tests.proves: The existing registration HTTP path does not disclose canonical Account existence through deterministic response classes.
tests.limits: This compares deterministic observable classes; it makes no timing-equality or rate-limit claim.

cases: Ordinary English and Afrikaans entry with legacy browser flags disabled; actual language links, invalid registration, legal artifact bytes, neutral pending/resend, protected TEST message, explicit confirmation, safe replay, locale return, no Session and denied protected access.
Persisted versions, age, acceptance locale/time, canonical PMR, verified Account, unique mailbox and scoped Audit E2 obligation.
Loaded stylesheet, keyboard focus, labels, reduced motion and widths 320/375/768/1280/1920.
tests.proves: Normal product HTTP/browser integration and owning durable state, separate from the TB-001 Catalog callback.
tests.limits: Chromium evergreen automation and synthetic protected TEST delivery only. No live provider, public approval, all-browser certification or sign-in journey.

cases: Exact development pair/documents; configuration mismatch; unknown document; withdrawn, superseded, missing supersession, wrong context, participant-effective entry and changed bytes.
tests.proves: Current bounded legal eligibility accepts only the pinned development evidence.
tests.limits: Pure negative manifest cases do not manufacture release approvals or edit canonical artifacts.

cases: Root EN/AF exact visible copy, legacy flags disabled, unsupported locale/disabled gate, unapproved candidate key refusal and safe telemetry/cache/referrer headers.
tests.proves: Normal entry admission and approved subset boundary.

cases: Scanner/passive GET/HEAD, real CSRF forms, proof privacy, wrong/invalid/currently denied proof and no implicit Session.
tests.limits: Existing owner races and restart coverage remain in Identity and TB-001 suites.

safe_extensions.summary: Extend registration through Identity.register/1 and the existing acceptance action; maintain rollback and replay tests when changing write set.
Use Communications and Audit owner interfaces for new consequences; inspect their current capability handoffs before extending.

reuse.summary: Reuse Identity.register/1 as caller interface and RegistrationBinding for immutable replay verification.
Reuse the existing database uniqueness and PMR reservation mechanisms; do not duplicate arbitration.

prohibited_shortcuts.summary: Do not call accept_new_registration or Account :register directly from delivery code to bypass owner validation/replay.
Do not introduce direct Repo/raw SQL/Ecto.Multi business writes, a second Account authority, or process-local uniqueness.
Do not equate MessageIntent, queued Audit work or verification_pending with email delivery, verified email or authenticated session.

proof_limitations: Descriptive source snapshot, subordinate to current governance and live Plane.
Schema/path/hash checks cannot establish the semantic truth of prose or declarations. Independent Master Gate must review claims against exact source/tests.

The historical P8-05 Markdown describes an older implementation snapshot. This record maps the bounded entry, registration and verification integration; deeper Communications execution remains in the existing P8-10 and TB-001 source-linked evidence.

WELL-131 is bounded software development. R-01 content/legal approval, R-02 OQ-035/OQ-036 delivery/abuse decisions and R-03 release/full FP-001 assessment remain open. No real-participant activation, production legal acceptance or launch email channel is delivered.

Cold start: inspect current routers and WELL-131, then router/boundary -> DevelopmentEntry -> Content readers -> RegistrationController -> Identity.register/1 -> existing acceptance transaction; follow pending -> Communications -> EmailVerificationController -> Identity.verify_email/1. Run the ordinary entry test and owner/proof regression suites.

No new durable lifecycle or schema. Existing operation bound/tombstoned states, Account verification/PMR invariants, transaction lock order and restart recovery remain as documented above and in proof.tb001.

WELL-109 locale regression uses exact rendered text rather than serialized HTML or short substring matching. New durable assertions filter fixture identifiers before Ash hydration; shared TEST risks remain tracked by WELL-114.
